notes: Ovulation counts and denominators agree with the served row. The abstract does not explicitly identify the denominators as randomised or analysed. Both groups received clomiphene citrate after 7 weeks of metformin or placebo; treatment continued with CC dose escalation. The reported stopping criteria are the available assessment window; no fixed end-of-treatment duration is stated. Pregnancy counts are a separate outcome.
